# 先進製程與設備智能輔助實驗室 (Advanced Process Control and Intelligent Equipment Laboratory)

> 國立臺灣科技大學 (NTUST) 研究實驗室，聚焦於 AI Agent、數位雙生與閉環智慧製造。
> A research laboratory at National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (NTUST), focused on AI Agents, Digital Twins, and closed-loop smart manufacturing.

本實驗室以 AI Agent 與數位雙生技術為核心，融合工業知識與先進控制，致力打造自主決策與人機協作的閉環智慧製造創新中心。

Centered on AI Agents and Digital Twins, driving closed-loop smart manufacturing through autonomous decision-making and human–AI collaboration.

This is the full companion to /llms.txt: it adds the complete current-member roster and the complete publication list, for AI tools that want to crawl deeper than the short overview.

## Research Pillars 研究重點

- **AI Agent 智慧代理人與決策支援 / AI Agent & Decision Support** — combining large language models (LLMs), optimization algorithms, and industrial knowledge (SOPs, standards, equipment parameters) into executable decision units via task decomposition, tool orchestration, reasoning verification, and human–AI collaboration.
- **數位雙生與實體場域導入 / Digital Twin & Real-World Deployment** — deploying digital twin, process optimization, and multi-agent coordination research directly into real industrial sites through close industry partnerships.
- **先進控制與閉環智慧製造 / Advanced Control & Closed-loop Manufacturing** — integrating process control theory, intelligent equipment design, and AI technology to address high-precision, high-efficiency manufacturing challenges, including scheduling, defect detection, predictive maintenance, and equipment health monitoring.
